summary: Physician, lawyer and author of the standard History of Long Island (1839/1843); John's 3rd cousin 8x removed.
bio: Path: John Thompson → Samuel → Jonathan → Dr. Samuel → Benjamin. Also 4C8R via Brewster (affected by the Brewster disproof) and probably 4C8R via Topping (his grandmother Mary Woodhull, b. 1711, appears to be a granddaughter of Temperance Topping). Called John Thompson 'the first Long Island ancestor of the compiler'.
